preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of cities n in each test case must be between 2 and 3000.
The total number of cities across all test cases must not exceed 3000.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the minimum possible number of roads assigned to the most used company, r.
The second line of output must contain exactly n-1 company assignments for the roads.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(c) <= 10**6 for c in stdout.splitlines()[1].split())
postconditions.description: Each company assignment must be a valid integer between 1 and 10^6.
